title: Claude built a Geekbot alternative, and my spec forgot one update could ping all of Slack #shorts
description:
Free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/async-standups?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=short&utm_campaign=async-standups

Claude built an async standup tool, a Geekbot alternative that asks everyone the same questions at 09:30 in their own time zone, tracks blockers until they are resolved and sends a daily summary by email and to Slack, from one written spec: all 32 acceptance checks passed, along with 167 automated tests. One of the 73 gaps the build exposed: the spec never said to escape what people type before it went to Slack, so one mention in an update could ping the whole channel; now every post has a set layout and typed text is escaped.

Geekbot's Starter plan is free for up to 10 users; Basic is $2.50 per participant per month billed yearly ($3 monthly), per geekbot.com/pricing (checked November 2026).

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera intro and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.
